blocks.en: Climate stress costs Taiwanese farms yield before the damage shows, and biological protectants are still hard to make, store and deliver cheaply. ReLEAF reads a field with a leaf sensor and the weather forecast, scores it as a stress index, and uses that to set a green lamp over engineered B. subtilis. The cells secrete ACC deaminase inside a hollow-fiber bioreactor that lets the protein out and holds the bacteria in.
blocks.text: Climate stress costs Taiwanese farms yield before the damage shows, and biological protectants are still hard to make, store and deliver cheaply. ReLEAF reads a field with a leaf sensor and the weather forecast, scores it as a stress index, and uses that to set a green lamp over engineered B. subtilis. The cells secrete ACC deaminase inside a hollow-fiber bioreactor that lets the protein out and holds the bacteria in.
blocks.zh: 在損傷顯現之前，氣候逆境就已讓臺灣農場付出產量代價，而生物性保護製劑至今仍難以便宜地生產、保存與送達。ReLEAF 以葉片感測器與天氣預報讀取一塊田，換算成逆境指數，再據此點亮工程化枯草桿菌上方的綠燈。細胞在中空纖維生物反應器內分泌 ACC 去胺酶，而這部反應器讓蛋白質出得去、把細菌留得住。

blocks.en: ReLEAF predicts environmental stress using field sensors and weather forecasts, then activates engineered Bacillus subtilis with green light to produce plant-protective proteins.
blocks.text: ReLEAF predicts environmental stress using field sensors and weather forecasts, then activates engineered Bacillus subtilis with green light to produce plant-protective proteins.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 以田間感測器與天氣預報預測環境逆境，再用綠光啟動工程化的 Bacillus subtilis，生產具植物保護功能的蛋白質。

blocks.en: Climate stress costs Taiwanese farms yield long before the damage is visible, yet biological protectants are still hard to manufacture, store, and deliver affordably.
blocks.text: Climate stress costs Taiwanese farms yield long before the damage is visible, yet biological protectants are still hard to manufacture, store, and deliver affordably.
blocks.zh: 在肉眼看見損傷之前，氣候逆境早已讓臺灣農場付出產量代價；而生物性的保護製劑，至今仍難以便宜地生產、保存並送到田裡。

blocks.en: Where it matterssmall farms, fragmented holdings, an average manager of 63.8
blocks.text: Where it matterssmall farms, fragmented holdings, an average manager of 63.8
blocks.zh: 問題落在哪裡小農、零碎的農地，經營者平均 63.8 歲

blocks.text: Forecast, detect, and turn on green lightleaf temperature and moisture, scored as a stress index
blocks.zh: 預報、偵測，然後開啟綠光葉片溫度與濕度，換算成逆境指數

blocks.en: CcaSR optogenetic systemgreen light, and WB800 secretes ACC deaminase
blocks.text: CcaSR optogenetic systemgreen light, and WB800 secretes ACC deaminase
blocks.zh: CcaSR 光遺傳系統綠光之下，WB800 分泌 ACC 去胺酶

blocks.en: Hollow-fiber bioreactor40 × 24 × 62 cm; protein out, cells in
blocks.text: Hollow-fiber bioreactor40 × 24 × 62 cm; protein out, cells in
blocks.zh: 中空纖維生物反應器40 × 24 × 62 cm；蛋白質出得去，細胞留得住

blocks.en: Deliver for plant protectionapplied by hand in our trials so far
blocks.text: Deliver for plant protectionapplied by hand in our trials so far
blocks.zh: 施用於植物保護目前的試驗都以人工施用

blocks.en: Two sensors that sit with the crop: a leaf sensor that reads a leaf’s own temperature and how wet its surface is, and an air sensor beside it for the air that leaf is standing in.
blocks.text: Two sensors that sit with the crop: a leaf sensor that reads a leaf’s own temperature and how wet its surface is, and an air sensor beside it for the air that leaf is standing in.
blocks.zh: 兩顆與作物待在一起的感測器：一顆葉片感測器讀取葉片本身的溫度與葉面有多濕，旁邊一顆空氣感測器則量測那片葉子所處的空氣。

blocks.en: Everything the system knows about conditions on the ground comes from these two, and their readings go straight to the math model. Both have been characterized on the bench so far; neither has run in a field.
blocks.text: Everything the system knows about conditions on the ground comes from these two, and their readings go straight to the math model. Both have been characterized on the bench so far; neither has run in a field.
blocks.zh: 系統對地面狀況的一切認識都來自這兩顆，讀值直接送進數學模型。兩者目前都只在實驗檯上做過特性量測，都還沒有在田間運轉過。

blocks.en: A model that scores how hard a field is being pushed. It combines daily weather and the forecast into a single stress index, fitted to 25 years of county rice harvests.
blocks.text: A model that scores how hard a field is being pushed. It combines daily weather and the forecast into a single stress index, fitted to 25 years of county rice harvests.
blocks.zh: 一個替田間所受壓力打分數的模型。它把每日天氣與預報合成單一的逆境指數，並以 25 年的縣市稻作收穫量擬合。

blocks.en: A day’s conditions go in and one number comes out, and that number is what calls for a dose. Predicting from earlier years only, its county error over 2016–2025 was 365 kg/ha against 419 for a plain trend line.
blocks.text: A day’s conditions go in and one number comes out, and that number is what calls for a dose. Predicting from earlier years only, its county error over 2016–2025 was 365 kg/ha against 419 for a plain trend line.
blocks.zh: 輸入一天的條件，輸出一個數字，而這個數字就是要不要投劑的依據。只用更早年份的資料往後推估時，它在 2016–2025 年的縣市誤差為 365 kg/ha，單純的趨勢線則是 419。

blocks.en: A printed rack for twenty-four culture tubes, each well lit by its own green or red LED on a program set in software.
blocks.text: A printed rack for twenty-four culture tubes, each well lit by its own green or red LED on a program set in software.
blocks.zh: 一座 3D 列印的管座，可放二十四支培養管，每一孔由自己的綠光或紅光 LED 照明，燈程在軟體裡設定。

blocks.en: The rack is how the light switch was characterized on the bench. A run holds one fixed light dose from start to finish, so each run measures the switch at one setting. Nothing steers the switch live yet, and the green strip has not been built into the reactor.
blocks.text: The rack is how the light switch was characterized on the bench. A run holds one fixed light dose from start to finish, so each run measures the switch at one setting. Nothing steers the switch live yet, and the green strip has not been built into the reactor.
blocks.zh: 光開關就是在這座管座上完成特性量測的。一次運轉從頭到尾維持同一個固定光劑量，所以每一次運轉只量到單一設定下的開關表現。目前還沒有任何東西能即時調控這個開關，綠光燈條也還沒裝進反應器。

blocks.en: CcaSR, a two-component light-sensing system carried inside the engineered Bacillus subtilis WB800. Green light falling on the culture turns the gene on; red light leaves it off.
blocks.text: CcaSR, a two-component light-sensing system carried inside the engineered Bacillus subtilis WB800. Green light falling on the culture turns the gene on; red light leaves it off.
blocks.zh: CcaSR，一套雙組分的光感測系統，帶在工程化的 Bacillus subtilis WB800 裡。綠光照到菌液上會把基因開啟；紅光則讓它維持關閉。

blocks.en: Green light is how a number from the model reaches the cells: it starts them making ACC deaminase, an enzyme produced by many plant growth-promoting bacteria, which breaks down the precursor of ethylene, the hormone a stressed plant makes.
blocks.text: Green light is how a number from the model reaches the cells: it starts them making ACC deaminase, an enzyme produced by many plant growth-promoting bacteria, which breaks down the precursor of ethylene, the hormone a stressed plant makes.
blocks.zh: 綠光是模型算出的數字抵達細胞的方式：它讓細胞開始製造 ACC 去胺酶——許多促進植物生長的細菌都會產生的酵素——這種酵素會分解乙烯的前驅物，而乙烯正是植物受逆境時所分泌的激素。

blocks.en: The computational work that chose and shaped the protectant proteins before anything was cloned: candidates docked against their plant targets, run in molecular dynamics and scored on structure.
blocks.text: The computational work that chose and shaped the protectant proteins before anything was cloned: candidates docked against their plant targets, run in molecular dynamics and scored on structure.
blocks.zh: 在任何選殖動作開始之前，先選出並形塑保護蛋白的計算工作：候選分子與其植物標的對接、跑分子動力學模擬，並就結構加以評分。

blocks.en: The sequences the wet lab builds come from this work. ACC deaminase is the one carried through to the reactor; LEA14, against the damage drought and salt do to proteins, and BoPEP4, aimed at the plant’s own defenses, were built as parts for later integration.
blocks.text: The sequences the wet lab builds come from this work. ACC deaminase is the one carried through to the reactor; LEA14, against the damage drought and salt do to proteins, and BoPEP4, aimed at the plant’s own defenses, were built as parts for later integration.
blocks.zh: 濕實驗所建構的序列都出自這項工作。ACC 去胺酶是一路帶進反應器的那一個；LEA14 針對乾旱與鹽分對蛋白質造成的損傷，BoPEP4 瞄準植物自身的防禦，兩者都已做成元件，留待日後整合。

blocks.en: The same engineered cells pushing the finished protein out through their wall and into the liquid around them.
blocks.text: The same engineered cells pushing the finished protein out through their wall and into the liquid around them.
blocks.zh: 同一批工程化細胞，把做好的蛋白質推出細胞壁，送進周圍的液體裡。

blocks.en: The cells are already inside the bioreactor, so nothing has to be carried there. Secretion puts the protein into the medium, within reach of the membrane, and means it can be collected without breaking a cell open.
blocks.text: The cells are already inside the bioreactor, so nothing has to be carried there. Secretion puts the protein into the medium, within reach of the membrane, and means it can be collected without breaking a cell open.
blocks.zh: 這些細胞本來就在生物反應器裡，因此蛋白質不必再被搬運過去。分泌把蛋白質送進培養液，也就送到了膜構得著的地方，而且不必破開細胞就能收集。

blocks.en: The vessel the engineered cells live in. A bottle of culture on a stirrer is pumped round a loop, through a hollow-fiber module (a cartridge packed with straw-like membrane fibers) and back, with the whole rig held at 37 °C in an incubator.
blocks.text: The vessel the engineered cells live in. A bottle of culture on a stirrer is pumped round a loop, through a hollow-fiber module (a cartridge packed with straw-like membrane fibers) and back, with the whole rig held at 37 °C in an incubator.
blocks.zh: 工程化細胞住的容器。攪拌器上的一瓶菌液由幫浦送進一條迴路，通過中空纖維模組（一個裝滿吸管狀膜纖維的匣）再回流，整組裝置放在培養箱裡維持 37 °C。

blocks.en: The cells stay on the inside of the fibers while the liquid carrying the protein crosses to the outside, so the machine lets protein out and keeps the bacteria in.
blocks.text: The cells stay on the inside of the fibers while the liquid carrying the protein crosses to the outside, so the machine lets protein out and keeps the bacteria in.
blocks.zh: 細胞留在纖維內側，帶著蛋白質的液體則穿到外側，所以這部機器讓蛋白質出得去，也把細菌留得住。

blocks.en: An OD600 meter built in the lab and plumbed into the culture loop. OD600 is how cloudy a culture is at 600 nm, which is the usual stand-in for how many bacteria are in it.
blocks.text: An OD600 meter built in the lab and plumbed into the culture loop. OD600 is how cloudy a culture is at 600 nm, which is the usual stand-in for how many bacteria are in it.
blocks.zh: 一台在實驗室裡做出來、接進菌液迴路的 OD600 量測儀。OD600 是菌液在 600 nm 下有多混濁，一般用來代表裡面有多少細菌。

blocks.en: It reads the culture continuously while the reactor runs, so growth can be followed without drawing a sample. Against a commercial BioDrop it fits a slope of 0.942 with R² 0.9997.
blocks.text: It reads the culture continuously while the reactor runs, so growth can be followed without drawing a sample. Against a commercial BioDrop it fits a slope of 0.942 with R² 0.9997.
blocks.zh: 反應器運轉時它持續讀取菌液，因此不必取樣就能追蹤生長。與市售 BioDrop 相比，斜率擬合為 0.942，R² 為 0.9997。

blocks.en: The software a run is watched through, with a model of the reactor kept alongside the real one: optical density, pH, four pressure traces and the pump and valve controls on a single screen.
blocks.text: The software a run is watched through, with a model of the reactor kept alongside the real one: optical density, pH, four pressure traces and the pump and valve controls on a single screen.
blocks.zh: 觀看一次運轉所用的軟體，並在真實反應器旁維持一個反應器的模型：光密度、pH、四條壓力曲線，以及幫浦與閥的控制，全在同一個畫面上。

blocks.en: A run is read and steered from here. A prediction can also be registered before a run starts, then scored against what the run did.
blocks.text: A run is read and steered from here. A prediction can also be registered before a run starts, then scored against what the run did.
blocks.zh: 一次運轉就從這裡讀取、從這裡操控。也可以在運轉開始前先登錄一份預測，事後再拿運轉的結果來對分。

blocks.en: Arabidopsis thaliana, the small mustard plant used as the standard laboratory model, grown on agar plates under a ladder of salt or heat and scored on root length and chlorophyll.
blocks.text: Arabidopsis thaliana, the small mustard plant used as the standard laboratory model, grown on agar plates under a ladder of salt or heat and scored on root length and chlorophyll.
blocks.zh: Arabidopsis thaliana（阿拉伯芥），實驗室常用的小型十字花科模式植物，種在瓊脂培養盤上，施以階梯式的鹽逆境或熱逆境，並以根長與葉綠素評分。

blocks.en: A protectant has to show here that it helps a plant. The assay itself is established; the stresses tested so far are heat and salinity.
blocks.text: A protectant has to show here that it helps a plant. The assay itself is established; the stresses tested so far are heat and salinity.
blocks.zh: 保護劑必須在這裡證明它真的幫得上植物。檢測方法本身已經成熟；目前測過的逆境是熱與鹽度。

blocks.en: A box of nutrient solution with a float of seedlings sitting over it, roots in the water: hydroponics, growing plants without soil.
blocks.text: A box of nutrient solution with a float of seedlings sitting over it, roots in the water: hydroponics, growing plants without soil.
blocks.zh: 一槽營養液，上面浮著一板幼苗，根泡在水裡：水耕，不用土壤種植物。

blocks.en: On a farm the protectant would go into the circulating water and reach the plants that way; the box is that route in miniature. In the trials so far it was added by hand, and connecting the bioreactor to growing crops is still a future step.
blocks.text: On a farm the protectant would go into the circulating water and reach the plants that way; the box is that route in miniature. In the trials so far it was added by hand, and connecting the bioreactor to growing crops is still a future step.
blocks.zh: 在農場上，保護劑會加進循環水裡，順著水路抵達植物；這個槽就是那條路線的縮小版。目前的試驗中它仍是人工加入，把生物反應器接上生長中的作物，還是未來的一步。

blocks.en: The calculation that reads how hard a field is being pushed and sets how much protectant it needs, and how bright the green lamp has to be to make that much.
blocks.text: The calculation that reads how hard a field is being pushed and sets how much protectant it needs, and how bright the green lamp has to be to make that much.
blocks.zh: 這項計算讀出田間承受了多大的壓力，據此決定它需要多少保護劑，以及綠燈要多亮才做得出這個量。

blocks.en: Its answer closes the loop: the setpoint the light plate apparatus runs at, and the schedule the farmer is shown.
blocks.text: Its answer closes the loop: the setpoint the light plate apparatus runs at, and the schedule the farmer is shown.
blocks.zh: 它的答案把整個迴路收起來：光照板裝置要運轉的設定值，以及農友看到的施用排程。

blocks.en: Rising temperatures, soil salinization, drought and disease all cut crop productivity. To see where in Taiwan they bite hardest, we mapped environmental and agricultural data across the island.
blocks.text: Rising temperatures, soil salinization, drought and disease all cut crop productivity. To see where in Taiwan they bite hardest, we mapped environmental and agricultural data across the island.
blocks.zh: 氣溫上升、土壤鹽化、乾旱與病害都會削減作物的生產力。為了看清這些壓力在臺灣哪裡咬得最深，我們把全島的環境與農業數據畫成地圖。

blocks.en: County nighttime temperature, 18:00 to 00:00, averaged throughout 2024, in degrees Celsius. The circles are scaled by the rice yield trend at each station over 2005 to 2024, in tonnes per hectare per year.
blocks.text: County nighttime temperature, 18:00 to 00:00, averaged throughout 2024, in degrees Celsius. The circles are scaled by the rice yield trend at each station over 2005 to 2024, in tonnes per hectare per year.
blocks.zh: 各縣市 18:00 至 00:00 的夜間氣溫，為 2024 年全年平均，單位為攝氏度。圓圈依各測站 2005 至 2024 年的稻作產量趨勢縮放，單位為公噸/公頃/年。

blocks.en: Warming, the size of a farm and the age of the person farming it all vary widely from region to region. A farmer does not experience a national average; they experience the conditions of their own field. Taiwan is exposed on top of that: more than 23 million people depend on around 769 000 hectares of cultivable land, and typhoons, drought and other climate-related disasters keep threatening what it produces.
blocks.text: Warming, the size of a farm and the age of the person farming it all vary widely from region to region. A farmer does not experience a national average; they experience the conditions of their own field. Taiwan is exposed on top of that: more than 23 million people depend on around 769 000 hectares of cultivable land, and typhoons, drought and other climate-related disasters keep threatening what it produces.
blocks.zh: 增溫幅度、農場大小，以及耕作者的年齡，都隨地區而大不相同。農友感受到的不是全國平均，而是自家田裡的條件。臺灣在這之上又更吃緊：超過兩千三百萬人依靠約 76.9 萬公頃的可耕地，而颱風、乾旱與其他氣候相關災害不斷威脅這些土地的產出。

blocks.en: Climate stress is local, so the answer to it has to work locally.
blocks.text: Climate stress is local, so the answer to it has to work locally.
blocks.zh: 氣候逆境是在地的，所以對策也必須在地運作。

blocks.en: Biofertilizers, biostimulants and bioprotectants are alternatives to conventional agrochemicals, but they are hard to deliver cheaply and reliably. They are made at central facilities, purified and formulated for stability, shipped to farms and kept in storage. Every step adds time and cost, and the farmer is still left to judge when to apply what arrives.
blocks.text: Biofertilizers, biostimulants and bioprotectants are alternatives to conventional agrochemicals, but they are hard to deliver cheaply and reliably. They are made at central facilities, purified and formulated for stability, shipped to farms and kept in storage. Every step adds time and cost, and the farmer is still left to judge when to apply what arrives.
blocks.zh: 生物肥料、生物刺激素與生物保護製劑，是慣行農業化學品之外的選項，但要便宜又穩定地送到田裡並不容易。它們在中央廠區製造，經純化與配方以求穩定，運到農場，再存放起來。每一個環節都疊上時間與成本，而東西送到之後，何時該用什麼，仍得由農友自己判斷。

blocks.en: A large commercial farm can usually cover the money, the equipment and the labor this takes. A small-scale farmer has less access to monitoring, to storage and to precise application. So the farms most exposed to local climate stress are also the ones furthest from biological protection.
blocks.text: A large commercial farm can usually cover the money, the equipment and the labor this takes. A small-scale farmer has less access to monitoring, to storage and to precise application. So the farms most exposed to local climate stress are also the ones furthest from biological protection.
blocks.zh: 大型商業農場通常負擔得起這一切所需的錢、設備與人力。小農較難取得監測、儲存與精準施用的條件。於是，最暴露在在地氣候逆境下的農場，也正是離生物保護最遠的那一群。

blocks.en: Taiwan’s holdings are fragmented, its technology is expensive and its workforce is aging: by 2021 the average agricultural manager was 63.8 years old. Precision agriculture is hard for a small farm to take up under those conditions, and a new system has to be simple enough to run without help.
blocks.text: Taiwan’s holdings are fragmented, its technology is expensive and its workforce is aging: by 2021 the average agricultural manager was 63.8 years old. Precision agriculture is hard for a small farm to take up under those conditions, and a new system has to be simple enough to run without help.
blocks.zh: 臺灣的農地零碎、技術昂貴、勞動力高齡化：到 2021 年，農業經營者的平均年齡是 63.8 歲。在這樣的條件下，小農很難導入精準農業，而新的系統必須簡單到不需要別人幫忙就能運作。

blocks.en: For a small-scale farmer the question is not whether better technology exists. It is whether it is affordable and easy enough to use in an ordinary working day.
blocks.text: For a small-scale farmer the question is not whether better technology exists. It is whether it is affordable and easy enough to use in an ordinary working day.
blocks.zh: 對小農來說，問題不是有沒有更好的技術，而是它夠不夠便宜、夠不夠好用，能不能放進尋常的一個工作日裡。

blocks.en: Taiwan’s markets connect the food people buy with the farmers who grow it. Behind the stalls, though, lettuce leaves are getting smaller, rice yields are falling and harvests are harder to protect. Growing conditions are becoming more extreme, and farmers are left defending crops against stresses they cannot see coming.
blocks.text: Taiwan’s markets connect the food people buy with the farmers who grow it. Behind the stalls, though, lettuce leaves are getting smaller, rice yields are falling and harvests are harder to protect. Growing conditions are becoming more extreme, and farmers are left defending crops against stresses they cannot see coming.
blocks.zh: 臺灣的市集把人們買的食物與種出它的農友連在一起。只是攤位背後，萵苣的葉子愈來愈小，稻作產量下滑，收成也愈來愈難保住。生長條件愈來愈極端，農友只能面對看不見何時到來的逆境守著作物。

blocks.en: That is where ReLEAF began, with one question: how can we give farmers a way to answer plant stress before the damage is permanent?
blocks.text: That is where ReLEAF began, with one question: how can we give farmers a way to answer plant stress before the damage is permanent?
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 就是從那裡開始的，帶著一個問題：我們要怎麼讓農友在損傷變成不可逆之前，就能回應植物的逆境？

blocks.en: Our first design released engineered bacteria into the soil to sense stress and make protectants where the stress was. A DesK–DesR system would read temperature and switch on a stress-response pathway. Professors and bioprocess experts told us two things were wrong with it: the bacteria could not be contained, and biological sensing was neither precise nor controllable enough. So we moved the sensing out of the cell, into electronic sensors and an AIoT (artificial intelligence of things) model that predicts plant stress, and built a hollow-fiber perfusion bioreactor that holds the bacteria in while letting the protectants out.
blocks.text: Our first design released engineered bacteria into the soil to sense stress and make protectants where the stress was. A DesK–DesR system would read temperature and switch on a stress-response pathway. Professors and bioprocess experts told us two things were wrong with it: the bacteria could not be contained, and biological sensing was neither precise nor controllable enough. So we moved the sensing out of the cell, into electronic sensors and an AIoT (artificial intelligence of things) model that predicts plant stress, and built a hollow-fiber perfusion bioreactor that holds the bacteria in while letting the protectants out.
blocks.zh: 我們最初的設計是把工程化細菌釋放到土壤裡，就地感測逆境、就地製造保護劑。DesK–DesR 系統會讀取溫度並開啟逆境反應路徑。教授與生物製程專家告訴我們其中有兩點不對：細菌無法被圍阻，而生物感測既不夠精準、也不夠可控。於是我們把感測移出細胞，交給電子感測器與一個預測植物逆境的 AIoT（人工智慧物聯網）模型，並做出一台中空纖維灌流式生物反應器，把細菌留在裡面，同時讓保護劑出來。

blocks.en: At the center of ReLEAF is a compact bioreactor built to make protectants on the farm that uses them.
blocks.text: At the center of ReLEAF is a compact bioreactor built to make protectants on the farm that uses them.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 的核心是一台小型生物反應器，為的是在用得到保護劑的那座農場上就地把它做出來。

blocks.en: First, a leaf sensor continuously monitors local crop conditions, including temperature and moisture. Our AIoT model combines these real-time measurements with weather forecasts and historical trends to predict plant stress and activate a green-light signal when conditions approach a damaging threshold. The data are displayed through an app interface, where farmers can view field conditions, receive stress alerts, and get maintenance reminders.
blocks.text: First, a leaf sensor continuously monitors local crop conditions, including temperature and moisture. Our AIoT model combines these real-time measurements with weather forecasts and historical trends to predict plant stress and activate a green-light signal when conditions approach a damaging threshold. The data are displayed through an app interface, where farmers can view field conditions, receive stress alerts, and get maintenance reminders.
blocks.zh: 首先，葉片感測器持續監測在地的作物狀況，包括溫度與濕度。我們的 AIoT 模型把這些即時量測與天氣預報、歷史趨勢結合起來，預測植物逆境，並在條件逼近會造成損傷的閾值時啟動綠光訊號。數據透過 App 介面呈現，農友可以在上面查看田間狀況、收到逆境警示，以及維護提醒。

blocks.en: Then, green light activates the CcaSR optogenetic system in engineered Bacillus subtilis WB800, triggering the production of ACC deaminase. LEA14 and BoPEP4 were also constructed as parts for future integration into the same optogenetic system. Each one is aimed at a different mechanism: ACC deaminase at the ethylene a stressed plant makes, LEA14 at the damage drought and salt do to proteins, BoPEP4 at the plant’s own defenses. So far, our plant testing has focused on heat and salinity stress.
blocks.text: Then, green light activates the CcaSR optogenetic system in engineered Bacillus subtilis WB800, triggering the production of ACC deaminase. LEA14 and BoPEP4 were also constructed as parts for future integration into the same optogenetic system. Each one is aimed at a different mechanism: ACC deaminase at the ethylene a stressed plant makes, LEA14 at the damage drought and salt do to proteins, BoPEP4 at the plant’s own defenses. So far, our plant testing has focused on heat and salinity stress.
blocks.zh: 接著，綠光啟動工程化 Bacillus subtilis WB800 中的 CcaSR 光遺傳系統，觸發 ACC 去胺酶的生產。LEA14 與 BoPEP4 也已建成元件，留待日後整合進同一套光遺傳系統。三者各自針對不同機制：ACC 去胺酶針對受逆境植物所生成的乙烯，LEA14 針對乾旱與鹽分對蛋白質造成的損傷，BoPEP4 針對植物自身的防禦。到目前為止，我們的植物測試集中在熱逆境與鹽度逆境。

blocks.en: The complete unit measures about 40 × 24 × 62 cm, small enough to stand beside the field it supplies. Inside it, the membrane lets the protectants through to the delivery pathway and keeps the bacterial cells behind. The hollow-fiber module is a sealed, replaceable cartridge, like an ink cartridge, so it can be swapped without anyone handling the culture.
blocks.text: The complete unit measures about 40 × 24 × 62 cm, small enough to stand beside the field it supplies. Inside it, the membrane lets the protectants through to the delivery pathway and keeps the bacterial cells behind. The hollow-fiber module is a sealed, replaceable cartridge, like an ink cartridge, so it can be swapped without anyone handling the culture.
blocks.zh: 整機尺寸約為 40 × 24 × 62 cm，小到可以立在它所供應的那塊田旁邊。機器內部，膜讓保護劑通往輸送路徑，把細菌細胞留在後面。中空纖維模組是一個密封、可更換的匣，像墨水匣一樣，因此更換時沒有人需要碰到菌液。

blocks.en: The protectants leave the machine in the permeate. In our plant trials so far, that permeate was collected and applied to the plants by hand; the bioreactor is not plumbed into a crop’s water supply.
blocks.text: The protectants leave the machine in the permeate. In our plant trials so far, that permeate was collected and applied to the plants by hand; the bioreactor is not plumbed into a crop’s water supply.
blocks.zh: 保護劑隨透過液離開機器。在我們目前的植物試驗中，這些透過液是收集起來、以人工施用於植物的；生物反應器並沒有接上作物的供水系統。

blocks.en: Delivery through hydroponic circulation or soil irrigation is part of the design, but it has not been built or tested; connecting the bioreactor directly to growing crops remains a future step.
blocks.text: Delivery through hydroponic circulation or soil irrigation is part of the design, but it has not been built or tested; connecting the bioreactor directly to growing crops remains a future step.
blocks.zh: 透過水耕循環或土壤灌溉輸送是設計的一部分，但尚未建造、也尚未測試；把生物反應器直接接上生長中的作物，仍是未來的一步。

blocks.en: What leaves the system is the protein, not the cells that made it. ReLEAF can therefore protect a field where and when stress is predicted without releasing engineered bacteria into it.
blocks.text: What leaves the system is the protein, not the cells that made it. ReLEAF can therefore protect a field where and when stress is predicted without releasing engineered bacteria into it.
blocks.zh: 離開系統的是蛋白質，不是做出它的細胞。因此 ReLEAF 能在預測到逆境的時間與地點保護一塊田，而不必把工程化細菌釋放到田裡。

blocks.en: Our project was continuously shaped by input from farmers, researchers, industry experts, and community members.
blocks.text: Our project was continuously shaped by input from farmers, researchers, industry experts, and community members.
blocks.zh: 我們的專題一路都由農友、研究人員、產業專家與社區成員的意見形塑。

blocks.en: We visited local farms to understand how farmers recognize plant stress, manage their crops, and make decisions about intervention. Their feedback emphasized the need for a system that is automated, accessible, and compatible with existing farming practices.
blocks.text: We visited local farms to understand how farmers recognize plant stress, manage their crops, and make decisions about intervention. Their feedback emphasized the need for a system that is automated, accessible, and compatible with existing farming practices.
blocks.zh: 我們走訪在地農場，了解農友如何辨認植物逆境、如何管理作物，以及如何決定何時介入。他們的回饋凸顯了一件事：這套系統必須自動化、容易取得，並且能與既有的農作方式相容。

blocks.en: We visited a hydroponic farm and consulted a plant-protectant company to better understand existing delivery systems and the barriers biological products face outside the laboratory. Their input helped us refine how ReLEAF could connect to hydroponic circulation, irrigation systems, and real agricultural workflows.
blocks.text: We visited a hydroponic farm and consulted a plant-protectant company to better understand existing delivery systems and the barriers biological products face outside the laboratory. Their input helped us refine how ReLEAF could connect to hydroponic circulation, irrigation systems, and real agricultural workflows.
blocks.zh: 我們走訪一座水耕農場，並請教一家植物保護製劑公司，以更了解既有的輸送系統，以及生物製品走出實驗室後會遇到的阻礙。他們的意見幫助我們釐清 ReLEAF 可以怎麼接上水耕循環、灌溉系統，以及真實的農務流程。

blocks.en: We then hosted a public forum that brought together farmers, company representatives, and community members to exchange perspectives and examine our bioreactor. These interactions helped us refine ReLEAF’s accessibility, safety, and real-world application.
blocks.text: We then hosted a public forum that brought together farmers, company representatives, and community members to exchange perspectives and examine our bioreactor. These interactions helped us refine ReLEAF’s accessibility, safety, and real-world application.
blocks.zh: 接著我們辦了一場公開論壇，把農友、企業代表與社區成員聚在一起交換觀點，也實地檢視我們的生物反應器。這些互動讓我們修正了 ReLEAF 的易用性、安全性與實際應用。

blocks.en: Between them these conversations set our agenda. Farmers pressed us on everyday operation and on cost; researchers and industry experts pressed us on biosafety validation, cartridge maintenance, regulation and scale-up.
blocks.text: Between them these conversations set our agenda. Farmers pressed us on everyday operation and on cost; researchers and industry experts pressed us on biosafety validation, cartridge maintenance, regulation and scale-up.
blocks.zh: 這些對話共同定下了我們的工作順序。農友追問的是日常操作與成本；研究人員與產業專家追問的是生物安全驗證、匣的維護、法規與放大生產。

blocks.en: To learn more about how stakeholder feedback shaped the development of ReLEAF, visit our Integrated Human Practices page.
blocks.text: To learn more about how stakeholder feedback shaped the development of ReLEAF, visit our Integrated Human Practices page.
blocks.zh: 想進一步了解利害關係人的回饋如何形塑 ReLEAF 的發展，請見我們的整合人文實踐頁面。
我們的願景與未來影響

blocks.en: We want a farm-scale biomanufacturing unit to be something any farmer can get hold of. Making plant-protective products on site and on demand would cut out the central factory, the long-distance shipping and the cold storage in between. What we are really after is a shorter path from a result in a laboratory to a treatment in a field.
blocks.text: We want a farm-scale biomanufacturing unit to be something any farmer can get hold of. Making plant-protective products on site and on demand would cut out the central factory, the long-distance shipping and the cold storage in between. What we are really after is a shorter path from a result in a laboratory to a treatment in a field.
blocks.zh: 我們希望農場規模的生物製造單元，是任何一位農友都拿得到的東西。就地、按需製造植物保護產品，可以省去中央工廠、長途運輸，以及中間的冷鏈儲存。我們真正想縮短的，是從實驗室裡的一個結果到田裡的一次處理之間那段路。

blocks.en: The design is modular, so the same unit could make other protein-based treatments and answer stresses we have not tested. The work in front of us is to measure protectant efficacy across crops and growth stages, to test cartridge integrity as a biosafety check, and to make the cartridge easier to maintain and replace.
blocks.text: The design is modular, so the same unit could make other protein-based treatments and answer stresses we have not tested. The work in front of us is to measure protectant efficacy across crops and growth stages, to test cartridge integrity as a biosafety check, and to make the cartridge easier to maintain and replace.
blocks.zh: 這個設計是模組化的，因此同一台機器可以製造其他以蛋白質為基礎的處理劑，回應我們尚未測試過的逆境。眼前的工作是量測保護劑在不同作物與不同生長階段的效果、把匣的完整性當成生物安全查核來測試，並讓匣更容易維護與更換。

blocks.en: After that it becomes a question of who runs the machine. We want to work with farmer collectives, research farms and agricultural organizations on how units would be distributed, serviced and shared, and equipment rental schemes or government subsidies could bring the cost of adoption down. Field data, continued stakeholder feedback and the regulatory route would then take ReLEAF to pilot-farm trials and beyond.
blocks.text: After that it becomes a question of who runs the machine. We want to work with farmer collectives, research farms and agricultural organizations on how units would be distributed, serviced and shared, and equipment rental schemes or government subsidies could bring the cost of adoption down. Field data, continued stakeholder feedback and the regulatory route would then take ReLEAF to pilot-farm trials and beyond.
blocks.zh: 再往後，就成了誰來操作這台機器的問題。我們希望與農民團體、試驗農場與農業組織合作，討論機器要如何配置、維修與共用，而設備租賃方案或政府補助可以把導入的成本壓下來。田間數據、持續的利害關係人回饋，以及法規途徑，則會把 ReLEAF 帶往示範農場試驗，並走得更遠。

blocks.en: The point of all of it is to put precise biological protection within reach of the small-scale farmers existing agricultural technology tends to pass over.
blocks.text: The point of all of it is to put precise biological protection within reach of the small-scale farmers existing agricultural technology tends to pass over.
blocks.zh: 這一切的重點，是把精準的生物保護，送到既有農業科技往往略過的小農手裡。

attrs.zh: 三條西方墨點法膠條的合成圖，每條都有管腔細胞裂解液、管腔培養液與殼側培養液三個泳道，分屬三組時間點。

attrs.en: The rig running inside an incubator: a 500 millilitre culture bottle on a stirrer, the hollow-fiber loop, the pump, an in-line filter and the pressure transducers on their boards.
attrs.zh: 培養箱內運轉中的裝置：攪拌器上一瓶 500 毫升菌液、中空纖維迴路、幫浦、一個線上濾器，以及裝在電路板上的壓力感測器。

attrs.en: Scatter plot of ReLEAF OD600 against BioDrop OD600, twenty points lying close to the dashed line of identity, annotated slope 0.942 and R squared 0.9997.
attrs.zh: ReLEAF OD600 對 BioDrop OD600 的散佈圖，二十個點緊貼著等值虛線，標註斜率 0.942、R 平方 0.9997。

attrs.en: A laptop screen showing the Digital Twin dashboard during a run: the optical density and pH charts, the four pressure traces, the membrane filtration warnings and the pump and feed valve controls.
attrs.zh: 運轉中的筆電畫面顯示數位孿生儀表板：光密度與 pH 圖表、四條壓力曲線、膜過濾警示，以及幫浦與進料閥的控制。

attrs.en: Eight square plates in two rows; columns 0, 75, 100 and 150 millimolar sodium chloride. Seedlings shrink sharply from left to right in both rows.
attrs.zh: 兩列共八塊方形培養盤；各欄依序為 0、75、100、150 毫莫耳濃度的氯化鈉。兩列的幼苗都由左而右急遽縮小。

attrs.en: Hydroponic boxes photographed from above, each holding a float of seedlings over nutrient solution.
attrs.zh: 由上方拍攝的水耕槽，每槽都有一板幼苗浮在營養液上。

attrs.en: Lamp setpoint against demand: a rising curve in green, clipped at a lamp floor below demand 0.015 and at saturation above 0.94.
attrs.zh: 燈光設定值對需求量：一條上升的綠色曲線，在需求 0.015 以下受燈光下限截斷，在 0.94 以上則達飽和。

attrs.en: A choropleth map of Taiwan titled Nighttime Temperatures and Rice Crop Yields. Counties are shaded by nighttime temperature in five bands from 20.51 to 27.26 degrees Celsius, blue to red, and white proportional circles show the rice yield trend from 2005 to 2024 at each station, from -0.044 to 0.058 tonnes per hectare per year. The hottest counties are in the north and the south.
attrs.zh: 一張標題為「夜間氣溫與稻作產量」的臺灣面量圖。各縣市依夜間氣溫分成五個級距著色，自 20.51 至 27.26 攝氏度，由藍至紅；白色的比例圓圈顯示各測站 2005 至 2024 年的稻作產量趨勢，自 -0.044 至 0.058 公噸/公頃/年。最熱的縣市在北部與南部。

attrs.en: Biological solutions
attrs.zh: 生物解方的缺口

attrs.en: A left-to-right flow diagram in seven steps: plant stresses, AIoT sensor, green light signal, B. subtilis CcaSR, hollow-fiber membrane, protectant secretion, plant protected.
attrs.zh: 由左至右的七步流程圖：植物逆境、AIoT 感測器、綠光訊號、B. subtilis 的 CcaSR、中空纖維膜、保護劑分泌、植物獲得保護。

attrs.en: A four-module diagram of the genetic circuit inside Bacillus subtilis. Module 1, PCB synthesis, turns heme into PCB with ho1::pcyA. Module 2, light sensing, is ccaS in the membrane, switched on by green light under stress and off by red light when there is none. Module 3, transcriptional output, is ccaR and the ccaR dimer. Module 4, output, shows translation and the folded protectant protein leaving the cell. Below, the ccaS/R circuit runs along the chromosome as four genes: ho1::pcyA, ccaS, ccaR and output.
attrs.zh: 枯草桿菌體內基因迴路的四模組示意圖。模組 1，PCB 合成，以 ho1::pcyA 把血基質轉成 PCB。模組 2，光感測，是位於細胞膜上的 ccaS，受逆境時由綠光開啟，無逆境時由紅光關閉。模組 3，轉錄輸出，是 ccaR 與 ccaR 二聚體。模組 4，輸出，顯示轉譯以及摺疊完成的保護蛋白離開細胞。下方，ccaS/R 迴路以四個基因沿著染色體排列：ho1::pcyA、ccaS、ccaR 與輸出基因。

attrs.en: A front-on render of the ReLEAF bioreactor: a black-framed cabinet holding a peristaltic pump, a bank of four pinch valves, two capped media bottles, a culture vessel and a white hollow-fiber membrane column, all linked by clear tubing.
attrs.zh: ReLEAF 生物反應器的正面算圖：黑色框架的櫃體裡有一台蠕動幫浦、一排四個夾管閥、兩瓶加蓋的培養液、一個培養槽，以及一支白色的中空纖維膜管柱，全部以透明管路相連。

attrs.en: Two ReLEAF students lean over a tray of small terracotta pots of seedlings on a laboratory bench, each pot marked with bamboo stakes. One, in a white lab coat, holds a stake and looks closely at a seedling; stacked sample boxes and labelled trays stand beside them.
attrs.zh: 兩位 ReLEAF 學生俯身看著實驗桌上一盤小陶盆幼苗，每個盆裡都插著竹籤標記。其中一位穿著白袍，手裡拿著竹籤，湊近端詳一株幼苗；旁邊疊著樣品盒與貼了標籤的盤子。

attrs.en: Three people crouch on a bare, sunlit field. A farmer holds a wicker basket of secateurs and reaches for a seedling in the soil; two ReLEAF students in team shirts crouch opposite, watching.
attrs.zh: 三個人蹲在一塊曬著太陽的裸田上。一位農友提著裝了剪定鋏的竹籃，伸手去摸土裡的幼苗；兩位穿隊服的 ReLEAF 學生蹲在對面看著。

attrs.en: Two ReLEAF students in team shirts look through circular openings cut into a green display wall at trays of hydroponic lettuce growing under strip lights, while a guide reaches in to lift a plant and show its bare roots.
attrs.zh: 兩位穿隊服的 ReLEAF 學生透過綠色展示牆上的圓形開口，看著條燈下一盤盤水耕萵苣；導覽人員伸手進去提起一株，展示它裸露的根。

attrs.en: Four ReLEAF students stand beside a projection screen headed with the Chinese words for application scenarios, which shows the bioreactor linked by arrows to a hydroponic greenhouse and to a soil-grown field. One student speaks into a microphone.
attrs.zh: 四位 ReLEAF 學生站在投影幕旁，幕上以中文寫著「應用情境」，顯示生物反應器以箭頭連向水耕溫室與土耕田區。其中一位學生正對著麥克風說話。
